decisions.statement: The rules read here are the addon's compiled ones rather than the authored ones.
The first account carrying a compiled block answers and the rest go unread.
A rule the addon left unnamed is named for its category and its place.
An ordered rule carries the id the addon gave it.
An ordered rule the addon left unnamed carries no id.
A key this side has never heard of is carried through untouched.
Every list a rule holds is named here, because Lua writes a list as a table keyed from one.
A list left unnamed reaches a reader as a record, and every reader takes a list.
An item rule the compiled config keys by item id is read back as a rule of its own.
An item rule read back is named for the item it is written against.
The compiled config carries no name for the item an item rule names.

definition: the compiled rule config the inventory addon wrote into its saved variables
